reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows to response.getWriter() output sink. Although code strips '-->' from param, this is insufficient sanitization - it allows other XSS payloads (encoded variants, alternative delimiters, or browser-specific behaviors). Proper mitigation requires HTML entity encoding, not fragile string replacement. Resolved sink value at line 19 is '<!-- ' + safe + ' -->' where safe = param.replace('-->', '') containing potentially malicious user input.

evidence.note: User input param flows through replace('-->') to response.getWriter() output without proper HTML encoding
